test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Millions of people ______ during the acute famine of Odisha.
solution: The correct answer is '**starved**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**starved**'. • It means** 'to suffer or die because you do not have enough food to eat; to make somebody/something suffer or die in this way'**. (भूखा रहने के कारण कष्‍ट पाना या मर जाना, भूखा मरना; किसी को भूखा रखकर कष्‍ट देना या मार देना, भूखा मारना) • *Example: to **starve** to death...* • *The given sentence expresses the fact that millions of people died during the acute famine of Odisha due to hunger.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Millions of people __**starved**__ during the acute famine of Odisha.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__** __ • You may feel that '**hungered**' can also be used but it is not true. • It is so because hungered means **to feel or suffer hunger **whereas starved means **to die of hunger.** • In a calamity like famine, people die because of an acute shortage of food. • Thus, '**starved**' is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **damaged**: to spoil or harm something, for example by breaking it. (हानि पहुँचाना, नुक़सान करना (जैसे कुछ तोड़ देना)) • **collapsed**: to fall down or break into pieces suddenly. (अचानक ढह जाना या टुकड़े-टुकड़े हो जाना) • **hungered**: feel or suffer hunger. (भूख महसूस करना या भुगतना।) 35:Tade, The correct answer is '**Muddel**'.
